close_reason: Landed in commit 3e1f92d. Dropped 'if !is_role_member' filter in validate_role_member_ops, renamed function to validate_space_patch_ops, added 11 tests in tests/channel_category_apply.rs. Single-user mode (MemoryBackend with CallerCtx=()) unaffected.
description:
Found by the JMAP-g7wu.2.4.6 do-beads triage 2026-05-13.

## Problem

The chat-server's `required_permissions_for_op` correctly maps the 6 Channel and Category semantic-mutation ops to the `manage_channels` permission (addChannels, removeChannels, updateChannels, addCategories, removeCategories, updateCategories). BUT the pre-validation pass `validate_role_member_ops` landed in JMAP-g7wu.2.4.3 explicitly filters to Role/Member ops:

    if !is_role_member { continue; }

This means the Channel/Category arms in `apply_space_patch_impl` reach the backend without a handler-side permission pre-check. The reference MemoryBackend's apply_space_patch impl for Channel/Category variants (landed in JMAP-g7wu.2.4.4 and .4.5) likewise does NOT re-verify `manage_channels` before applying the mutation. The cascading-semantics tests pass because they don't exercise the permission boundary — they always run as an admin caller.

Net effect: a caller without `manage_channels` can today successfully `addChannels`, `removeChannels`, etc.

## Spec authority

draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §Space/set explicitly states that each Channel/Category mutation key requires `manage_channels`. The reference impl's mapping in `required_permissions_for_op` correctly encodes this; only the enforcement is missing.

## Acceptance

- Extend `validate_role_member_ops` to also pre-check `manage_channels` on the 6 Channel/Category ops (drop the `if !is_role_member` filter and gate by the permission map instead). Rename the function if appropriate (e.g. `validate_structural_ops`).
- Backend's apply_space_patch impl in `MemoryBackend` re-verifies `manage_channels` atomically with each Channel/Category arm (defense-in-depth + canonical enforcement, matching the Role/Member pattern from .4.3).
- Tests in `tests/role_member_apply.rs` or a new `tests/channel_category_apply.rs`:
  * Non-member caller attempts addChannels → SetError::Forbidden.
  * Member with only `@everyone` (no `manage_channels`) attempts removeChannels → SetError::Forbidden.
  * Caller with `manage_channels` succeeds.
  * Whole-patch reject on permission failure: mixed-op patch (addChannels + addCategories where caller lacks manage_channels) is fully rolled back, no partial mutation.
- Existing tests that exercise Channel/Category ops continue to pass (they run as admin and were not exercising the missing gate).

## Out of scope

- The manage_space gate (separate bead JMAP-g7wu.2.4.13).
- The Role/Member gate (already landed in JMAP-g7wu.2.4.3).
- ULID migration (separate bead).
- Spec-side clarification of permission inheritance / propagation (this bead implements what the spec already says).

## Cross-references

- JMAP-g7wu.2.4.3 — the Role/Member pre-check + backend enforcement (the pattern this bead extends)
- JMAP-g7wu.2.4.4 / .4.5 — Channel and Category backend impls that need the re-verify
- JMAP-g7wu.2.4.6 — the test-matrix bead this finding came out of
- workspace AGENTS.md 'Caller identity (foundation seam)' — the policy this gate operationalizes
title: Space/set Channel and Category ops: enforce manage_channels permission gate
